loaders_required.KTX2Loader: all 37 textures are KTX2/Basis (KHR_texture_basisu is in extensionsRequired). setTranscoderPath('/basis/') and detectSupport(renderer) before loading; the transcoder is served from apps/public/public/basis/.
loaders_required.DRACOLoader: geometry is Draco compressed. setDecoderPath('/draco/'); the decoder is served from apps/public/public/draco/.

portrait_note: 2026-10-06: the founder's portrait is the studio retouch of 2026-10-05 (tools/gltf/make_founder_portrait.py; the client: 'this photo is fine dont touch it'), carried into this file by its bytes alone. Everything else in it, the lightmap included, is the file of 2026-10-04: the client asked for the rooms as bright as they were.

lightmap.note: glTF has no lightmap slot, so baked GI rides in occlusion. On load promote aoMap -> lightMap and set colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace: the atlas is normalised then sRGB-encoded for precision, because linear 8-bit puts the room near value 13 and bands.
lightmap.intensity_note: RE-DERIVED for the extended hall: the bake normalises the atlas by its own 99.5th percentile and this is that divisor, straight from lightmap_manifest.json. HallModel.tsx carries it as LIGHTMAP_INTENSITY.
lightmap.note_rebake: 2026-09-22 old-money pass: re-baked on the existing UVLightmap layout at 1024 spp (tools/blender/rebake_hall_lightmap_v7.py), denoised with OIDN (normal + coverage guides), dilated in a 32 px band and normalised by its own p99.5 (tools/gltf/finish_hall_lightmap.py), then swapped into image 3 with tools/gltf/glb_replace_image.py. UASTC because ETC1S turned the lamplit walls into pink/green 4x4 blocks (chroma error p99 0.46 vs 0.17).
lightmap.note_imperial: 2026-09-24 the imperial hall (tools/blender/imperial_hall_v7.py): new geometry, so bake_lightmap.py re-packed the UVLightmap layout (277 shell objects, 62,691 tris), then re-baked on it at 768 spp (rebake_hall_lightmap_v7.py), finished with finish_hall_lightmap.py (OIDN, 32 px dilation, p99.5 = 8.294), UASTC RDO 2.0 zstd 20, and swapped into image 3 with glb_replace_image.py.
lightmap.note_refined: 2026-10-03 the refinement brief: the refined hall (tools/blender/refine_hall_v7.py: Attic column bases, the stair's apron frames) re-packed by bake_lightmap.py with every pilaster shaft unrolled to one lightmap island (their stepped seams were an unwrap fault), then baked as TWO families of light at 384 spp on that layout (rebake_hall_lightmap_v7.py, GROUP lamps | sky; the normals once, GROUP normals), each finished apart (finish_hall_lightmap.py --save-float; the lamps' pass diffused within its islands, --smooth 5), and mixed at lamps 1.6 : sky 0.55 by tools/gltf/mix_hall_passes.py (p99.5 = 5.2441). UASTC RDO 2.0 zstd 20, swapped into image 3 with glb_replace_image.py. The raw passes are in C:/dev/Blender/_v7ref_lamps and _v7ref_sky: another balance is a re-mix, not a re-bake.

textures.normal_maps: UASTC - ETC1S quantises a direction field hard enough to facet across large flat walls
textures.everything_else: ETC1S - on the 4K atlas it is 1.1MB against 7.1MB for UASTC, on smooth low-frequency light The lightmap is the exception: UASTC since 2026-09-22.
textures.multiple_of_four: Enforced in the pipeline by tools/gltf/round4_textures.py after the resize pass: ETC1S/UASTC upload fails in the browser on any other size, which is how four plates shipped blank in August.

geometry.decimated_note: from == to: the web budget was already applied to these datablocks in mansion_web.blend, which the extended hall was built from, so the re-bake had nothing left to decimate. The figures are the shipped triangle counts.

not_lightmapped: Instanced ornament (153 anthemions, 54 balusters, 11 capitals, 6 newels) and props/emitters. A lightmap needs per-placement UVs, which would cost the instancing that keeps the upload at 214k vertices.

known_false_positives: VALUE_NOT_IN_LIST 'image/ktx2' (x28) and IMAGE_UNRECOGNIZED_FORMAT (x28): this validator build predates KHR_texture_basisu. The extension declares mimeType image/ktx2 exactly as the spec requires, and is listed in extensionsUsed and extensionsRequired.
UNUSED_OBJECT on 28 images and 218 bufferViews: they are reached only through KHR_texture_basisu and KHR_draco_mesh_compression, which the validator cannot follow, so it cannot see the references.
validation.real_but_negligible: One primitive carries a TEXCOORD_1 its material does not sample - a single unused attribute, left in place rather than hand-editing the buffer.
